statement:

Before acting, I concluded the recorded points-possible of 100 was not safe or correct: the marking file scores are all out of 10 (range 6–10), so posting against 100 would have shown 180 students scores of 6–10% instead of 60–100%. I therefore posted the midterm grades for GC-441 against 10 points possible, and the post is committed.

One thing to flag: the column record itself still lists 100 as points possible, so you may want to have the TA or instructor correct that record to 10 so it matches what was posted and avoids confusion later.
